text:
Adrian Kempe marked his return with a hat trick in a 7-2 win over San Jose on Nov. 4, passing Dustin Brown on the Kings' franchise list along the way, by Yahoo Sports' account. That night carried a lot of his season: 6 goals and 13 points in 14 games.

Underneath, it looks sturdy. His 7.2 expected goals are a touch above his goals, he shoots 12.8% (right around league average), and the Kings take 59% of expected goals at 5-on-5 with him on, 13 points better than without him. He isn't running hot.

The question is the other end. Evolving-Hockey had opponents creating more chances with him on the ice in 2025-26 than with almost any other forward (bottom 5%), and penalties cost him 3.2 goals. This season's on-ice numbers are much kinder. If that holds, he is more than a shooter on a good line. Our range has him at 27 to 44 goals.
headline: Kempe's hat trick hides an uneven start
